text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it lowered the commercial paper rating of Louisiana-Pacific Corp to D One from D One Plus.

It said the action reflects the company's less robust liquidity, its new strategy to pursue growth through acquisitions and its willingness to operate with higher though still moderately conservative financial leverage.
Duff & Phelps said there has been a shift in Louisiana-Pacific's balance sheet over the past two years toward higher debt levels and lower cash balances.

It added that increased acquisition activity makes it less likely that leverage will come down significantly from current levels, though leverage could decline over short periods following asset sales or other cash-raising moves, Duff & Phelps said.
